complexity.correctness_reason: best_buy is hard-coded to the capped maximum price 100, so on the generalized input prices = [200, 300] it returns 200 instead of the true answer 100.
complexity.notes: Clean single pass. The initialization best_buy = 100 bakes in the statement's price cap; float('inf') or prices[0] would make it robust for any price range.
complexity.summary: Single pass over prices, maintaining the lowest price seen so far as the buy candidate and updating the best profit at each day. O(n) time, O(1) space.
